text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos didn't show up for training.
Worried, I searched around for her, and—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy, I'm so sorry...!
My hair was sticking up and looking uncool, and, um...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
My big sister chewed me out big time, too.
She said, 'Breaking promises is totally uncool.'
...She was completely right, of course.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I won't do anything so uncool ever again!
So please...
I want to run with you again...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed genuinely remorseful,
so I accepted her apology, and we vowed to make a fresh start.
